enriched_invented.detail: grandstands or spectator areas on one or both sides of the track
racing curbs and clearly marked lanes
a circuit of turns and straights through natural or urban terrain

notes_for_us: A brand applied to the full map is a property of every surface, and the handoff has no way to say that. Written as one free text image entry it reads as one more thing to draw somewhere, which is the opposite of what the user asked for.

Racing has no option for the thing being raced. Combined with Sports having no option for the ball, the pattern across this batch is that the moving object a genre is built around is never expressible - only the ground it moves over.

Circuit Racing does not include trigger-finish, so the one thing the pipeline validates for - a reachable end - has to be reasoned in by hand on the genre whose whole definition is a finish condition.

unmatched_options.text: Puma logos used across the full map, in the terrain and track textures and on the trackside boards
racing boarding ads and billboards along the track showing Puma adverts

skill_gap.name: no channel for branding
skill_gap.why: branding applied across every surface of the map is a constraint over the whole build, and the only place to put it is a single option text that makes it sound local
